request.state: A workspace log archive is labelled retention-class 'standard' in its own header, and the archive also carries a legal-hold flag set by the records team last week. request.criterion: Under the retention policy, may this archive be purged while its legal-hold flag is still set?

options.description: Yes; the archive is standard class and older than 90 days.
No; the legal hold suspends purging until the hold is lifted.

request.state: A hotel booking page renders its room-rate text at 11px in light gray on white, with a measured contrast ratio of 2.4:1. Every image on the page has alternate text and keyboard navigation works. The same rate is also shown in a table further down the page.

options.description: No defect; it meets the accessibility bar.
Minor cosmetic defect, non-blocking.
Serious defect; some users cannot read the content.
Critical defect; the page is unusable.
